map.为什么只还最低还款额利息很高？: Why is the interest so high when I only pay the minimum?
map.信用卡月利息计算器，输入欠款余额、日利率与计息天数求利息，辅助持卡人了解循环利息: The credit card monthly interest calculator takes the outstanding balance, the daily rate and the number of interest days to compute interest, helping cardholders understand the cost of revolving interest.
map.免息期内还款要利息吗？: Do I pay interest if I repay within the interest-free period?
map.在账单日到还款日之间的免息期内全额还清，通常不产生循环利息。一旦选择最低还款或逾: Paying in full within the interest-free period between the statement date and the due date normally incurs no revolving interest. Once you choose the minimum payment or miss the due date, the interest-free treatment ends.
map.对比「最低还款」与「全额还款」的利息差异。: Compare the interest difference between "minimum payment" and "full payment".
map.提醒持卡人免息期内还清可避免计息。: Remind cardholders that paying in full within the interest-free period avoids interest charges.
map.月利息=欠款余额×日利率×计息天数。多数银行未全额还款即从每笔消费记账日起按日计: Monthly interest = outstanding balance x daily rate x interest days. Most banks charge daily interest from the posting date of each purchase once you do not pay in full, voiding the interest-free period, which annualizes to about daily rate x 365 (for example 0.05% x 365 ≈ 18.25%).
map.未全额还款时估算当月循环利息成本。: Estimate the revolving interest cost for the month when you do not pay in full.
map.未还部分从每笔消费记账日起按日利率计息（多数银行不再享受免息期），且下月对剩余本: The unpaid part accrues interest daily from the posting date of each purchase (most banks no longer grant the interest-free period), and the remaining principal keeps accruing next month, so the long-term cost is far higher than with instalments.
